gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically proven diagnosis of glioblastoma (or gliosarcoma as a subtype of glioblastoma) confirmed by central pathology review

candidate_evidence.quote: adding lomustine to standard chemotherapy with temozolomide and radiation therapy versus temozolomide and radiation therapy alone in shrinking or stabilizing newly diagnosed MGMT methylated glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: ARM II (radiation therapy, temozolomide, lomustine): ... Patients also receive lomustine PO on day 1 of each cycle and temozolomide PO QD on days 2-6 of each cycle.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: alkylating agent; damages the cell's DNA

role_evidence.quote: Arm I (radiation therapy, temozolomide): Patients undergo radiation therapy 5 days per week and receive temozolomide PO QD for 6 weeks

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: alkylating agent; damages the cell's DNA

flag.reason: Given in both arms but with a modified schedule in arm II; coded soc_backbone.

source_quote.quote: MGMT promoter with methylation confirmed by central pathology review.
IDH mutation testing ... must be performed as part of standard of care and no mutation must be found (i.e IDH wildtype).

coder_notes: Lomustine is an established GBM therapy under test in a new combination/setting, so established_therapy_experiment; no candidate agent. Lymphocyte counts are exploratory outcomes, not molecular biomarkers.
